svg.title: Two cross-sections of the upper films, one above the other, cut off at the bottom. Before the step two thick metal shapes lie under a thin pale film and a thick green film that covers everything. After it a thick violet resist layer with a flat top covers the slice except for one window over the middle of the left-hand metal shape, where the green film is bare.

Before the step two thick metal shapes lie under a thin pale film and a thick green film that covers everything. svg.text: Resist is coated, exposed through the pad reticle
and developed, opening a window over the pad.
After: resist with an opening over the pad
The lower part of the slice is not drawn.
Not to scale. Thin films are drawn thicker than they are.
